content.text:
I added a row-group pruning callback to the string version of `contains`. I couldn't build or run anything, so it is untested.

The callback is in `src/function/scalar/string/contains.cpp` and follows the one `prefix` already has. For `contains(col, 'const')` it returns "always false" in three cases:
- The column's string stats show every string is shorter than the needle. That is the case in your repro: one row group has max length 5 and the needle is 30 characters, so it should now be skipped.
- All values in the row group are NULL.
- The needle is NULL.

It does not prune an empty needle, or any case where the max string length isn't known. I didn't use the min/max stats, since a substring match can't be ruled out from the min/max stats.

I didn't add a test. A sqllogictest based on your repro would need to check "Row Groups Scanned" from `EXPLAIN ANALYZE`.

status_detail: contains() prunes row groups whose max string length is below needle
